title: A loan and its Loan opened event both survive a restart
when: On a database file, registers a member, adds a tool and borrows it, then closes the database and opens it again on the same file.
then: Expects the loan read back, active, and its Loan opened event in the outbox.

title: A borrow whose event cannot be saved leaves no loan behind
when: On a database file with a member and a tool, removes the outbox table, then borrows the tool.
then: Expects the borrow to fail and no loan saved.

title: A returned loan, with its return, is still there after a restart
when: On a database file, borrows a tool and returns it three days later in good condition with a note, then closes the database and opens it again.
then: Expects the loan read back with its return: its condition and note.
